_about: Public-domain John Scott Lidgett (1854-1953), Wesleyan Methodist theologian and founder of the Bermondsey Settlement, for the Word Hoard: The Spiritual Principle of the Atonement, The Fatherhood of God, The Christian Religion, Apostolic Ministry, God in Christ Jesus, and Methodism in the Modern World. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 96 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

lidgett-atonement: The spiritual principle of the atonement : as a satisfaction made to God for the sins of the world (Cincinnati : Jennings & Graham, 1897)
lidgett-fatherhood: The fatherhood of God in Christian truth and life (Edinburgh, T. & T. Clark, 1902)
lidgett-christian-religion: The Christian religion, its meaning and proof (London, Culley, 1907)
lidgett-apostolic-ministry: Apostolic ministry : sermons and addresses (London : C.H. Kelly, [190)
lidgett-methodism: Methodism in the modern world (London, The Epworth Press [etc.], 1929)
